name: claude-modes
description: Modal harness for Claude Code: named working stances that reshape the catalog at the harness level via a 5-tier cascading configuration system. Modes are settings overlays; per-repo isolation via <repo>/.claude/settings.local.json; hooks live in ~/.claude/settings.json (machine-wide) or <repo>/.claude/hooks/hooks.json (per-repo), never in any cascade YAML. Solves harness-bloat at scale.
